name: create_python_sessionize_events
description: Builds an event sessionizer (30-min inactivity gap) consumed by an existing summary renderer
prompts: An existing summary.py imports count_sessions from a sessions module and renders it, but sessions.py does not exist yet. Create sessions.py defining count_sessions(events) where events is a list of (user, timestamp) pairs (timestamp is an int of epoch seconds). For each user, split that user's events into sessions: sort the user's timestamps ascending, start a new session on the first event and whenever the gap from the previous event is STRICTLY GREATER THAN 1800 seconds (a gap of exactly 1800 stays in the same session). Return a dict {user: number_of_sessions}. Skip any event whose user is not a non-empty string or whose timestamp is not an int (note: booleans are not valid timestamps). Do not modify summary.py.
